notes:
What's new

- The update check now works on networks where the Windows internet stack stalls on IPv6 and never reaches GitHub. It falls back to the curl client built into Windows.
- Failed checks write the exact network error to the update log so problems are diagnosable.
- Everything else is unchanged: background download, Restart to install, silent relaunch.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.6 - update connectivity fix: when WinINet times out (for example on networks advertising an unreachable IPv6 route) the updater falls back to the built-in Windows curl client for the manifest, signature and installer, and logs WinINet error codes.
